decks.notes: This Esper Control deck focuses on manipulating the game state and disrupting the opponent's strategies. The key concept revolves around using a combination of powerful spells and artifacts to control the game and create advantage. It utilizes cards like Yawgmoth's Will and Tinker to access and play key cards from the graveyard. It also combines efficient control spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares with card draw and library manipulation effects like Brainstorm and Sensei's Divining Top. The deck is designed to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent, ultimately leading to victory.

This deck aims to control the game by utilizing cards like Force of Will and Paradoxical Outcome to manipulate the battlefield. The key strategy involves using Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play quickly. The deck also includes various artifact and mana ramp cards to generate resources and outpace opponents. With cards like Tinker and Bolas's Citadel, the deck can create explosive plays and overwhelming advantages. Overall, the deck focuses on disrupting opponents while establishing a strong board presence and ultimately dominating the game.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively use Bazaar of Baghdad to fuel graveyard cards like Vengevine and Hollow One, while also disrupting opponents with Wasteland and Force of Will. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures and disruptive spells, using cards like Noxious Revival and Force of Vigor to maintain advantage. The inclusion of Squee, Goblin Nabob and Master of Death allows for recurring threats, while Poxwalkers and Chalice of the Void provide additional disruption. Overall, the deck is focused on fast, aggressive gameplay and disrupting opponents' strategies.

The deck focuses on using the card Doomsday to set up a winning combo by manipulating the top cards of the library to guarantee a victory condition. It utilizes various spells and tutors to find and assemble the necessary pieces for the combo quickly and efficiently, while also including disruption elements like countermagic and removal to protect the combo or disrupt the opponent's strategy. With its high level of consistency and powerful win conditions, the deck is designed to win the game in a quick and decisive manner.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful graveyard synergies to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures like Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. The inclusion of cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier help fuel the graveyard while cards like Force of Vigor and Collector Ouphe disrupt opponent's strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with early aggression and efficient use of resources, combining graveyard recursion with traditional aggro strategies to create a versatile and powerful deck in the Vintage 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively fill the graveyard with cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder, allowing for early creature drops like Vengevine and Hollow One. The deck also focuses on disruption with cards like Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its creatures and maintain control of the game. The inclusion of cards like Force of Vigor and Subtlety provides additional utility and flexibility, while utilizing cards like Squee, Goblin Nabob and Master of Death for card advantage and resilience.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with aggressive artifact creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruptive artifacts and tax effects. The key strategy is to leverage Mishra's Workshop and Urza's Saga to generate mana and tutor for impactful artifacts like Sarevok's Tome and Nettlecyst. Additionally, cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere slow down the opponent and give the deck an advantage in resource management. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator provides versatility and additional disruptive options to control the game tempo and secure a win.

The deck revolves around using artifacts and card draw to generate mana and card advantage, ultimately leading to a powerful combo utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Tinker to draw into win conditions such as Time Vault or Bolas's Citadel. By controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Will and powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils, the deck aims to create a dominating board state and win the game efficiently through its powerful combo pieces.

The key concept of this Bazaar Aggro deck is to utilize the graveyard as a resource to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad to fill the graveyard with creatures like Hogaak, Bloodghast, and Vengevine, the deck aims to quickly establish a strong board presence and apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Collector Ouphe and Force of Vigor to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Hexdrinker and Hollow One provide additional threats to close out the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo with Coveted Jewel, utilizing mana acceleration from Mishra's Workshop and other artifacts. The deck aims to power out Coveted Jewel quickly to generate card advantage and mana advantage. It also includes control elements like Force of Will and Pact of Negation to protect the combo pieces. Additionally, it utilizes Urza's Saga and Mystic Forge to create synergy with artifacts in the deck, allowing for additional card advantage and utility. The deck aims to win the game through overwhelming advantage gained from the Coveted Jewel combo.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy by playing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Solitude and Seasoned Dungeoneer. The deck also utilizes mana denial strategies with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, along with disruptive artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere. The goal is to slow down the opponent's game plan and overwhelm them with efficient creatures, ultimately leading to victory through a combination of disruption and aggression.

This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while slowing down the opponent with disruptive cards. The deck aims to control the game by limiting the opponent's resources and options while applying pressure with efficient creatures. By utilizing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Archon of Emeria, the deck disrupts the opponent's plans and forces them to play on the back foot. The inclusion of cards like Trinisphere and Chancellor of the Annex further hinders the opponent's ability to cast spells effectively. The deck aims to capitalize on this disruption to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Dreadhorde Arcanist and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, backed up by disruptive spells and card advantage engines like Force of Will, Ancestral Recall, and Treasure Cruise. By efficiently deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and resilience. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional value to the deck by allowing for recurring threats and spells from the graveyard.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and land destruction to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying powerful threats to quickly close out the game. Mishra's Workshop allows for explosive starts, Ancient Tomb provides additional mana acceleration, and Sphere of Resistance slows down opponents' spells. Urza's Saga helps search for key artifacts like Nettlecyst and Walking Ballista, while Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility. The deck is designed to overwhelm opponents with a mix of aggressive creatures like Foundry Inspector and Patchwork Automaton, backed up by disruptive elements like Lodestone Golem and Chalice of the Void.

The deck aims to control the game by using counterspells and removal spells while generating card advantage through card draw effects. The key strategy revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Hullbreaker Horror. Other key cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Oko, Thief of Crowns provide additional disruption and utility. The mana base is designed to support the deck's heavy reliance on blue mana sources, with snow-covered lands and artifact acceleration providing additional flexibility and consistency in gameplay.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of disruptive spells and powerful planeswalkers. By utilizing cards like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Force of Vigor to counter and remove threats, as well as Wrenn and Six and Oko to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's board state, this deck aims to control the game and eventually win through the incremental advantage provided by its planeswalkers and efficient threats like Ragavan. The deck also includes a toolbox aspect with Living Wish to search for specific answers when needed.
